## Why trusted data changes everything

MTM gives your agency the competitive edge, transforming campaigns from speculation into pitches that guarantee client confidence

Trustworthy Data

300,000+ Canadians surveyed to date.

Our independent, nationally representative samples allow for detailed comparisons against your internal data and other sources. With the MTM, know where and how Canadians are engaged with an exhaustive array of media platforms and leave nothing up to chance.

Social Media Usage

![Social Media Usage](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/solutions/advertising/insight-1.svg)

Precision Targeting

Get deep into the details.

The MTM allows you to see Canada in high definition. Our large library of demographic details lets you filter data by income brackets, age groups, families, racialized groups and more.

## How MTM fits the way you work already

You don't open a research tool and start clicking. You have a business question. MTM is built to answer it, at every stage of your workflow.

01 Plan

Understand the audience before the strategy takes shape.

Use MTM to profile the target audience pre-brief. Know their viewing, streaming, and media habits so your strategy starts from evidence, not assumption.

[Trending Tool ](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/tools/analytic-tools/#trending-tool)[MTM Reports](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/insights/)

02 Pitch

Design your next pitch faster and smarter

Whether you’re planning a high-impact Out-of-Home campaign, a localized digital blitz, or a retail pop-up, we give you the power to defend your pitch every step of the way.

[Census Tool ](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/tools/census-tool/)[Data Analysis Tool](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/tools/analytic-tools/#data-analysis-tool)

03 Present

Turn the data into the slide that closes the room.

Export clean, presentation-ready charts and cross-tabs directly from the platform. When a client pushes back, you have the national dataset behind every number.

[MTM Reports ](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/insights/)[YourData](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/tools/analytic-tools/#yourdata)

## MTM in Action for Ad Agencies

Use the MTM to sharpen your pitches, validate plans and win more business — then apply the same thinking to your clients.

Use Case

A client is interested in promoting a new line of microwavable meals, with a focus on newcomer populations.

Ad exposureRegionsDevices usedIncome

How to leverage this

Leverage the Data Analysis Tool to find the income levels, devices used to maximize exposure.

Use Case

A luxury car brand is interested in reaching the most affluent households in Canada.

FSAPostal CodeIncome

How to leverage this

Leverage the Ranker feature in the census tool to find out where the wealthiest Canadians reside and target your campaign effectively.
